description: Conversation-ready object schema for an AI screening agent, plus a worked example flow for a Software Engineer candidate. Each object represents one turn: the question the AI should ask next, how to validate the answer, and where to go on success/failure.

object_schema.role_id: string — matches role_id in the question dataset
object_schema.language: string — BCP-47 code, e.g. en, hi, es
object_schema.question_id: string — matches question_id in the dataset
object_schema.resolved_text: string — template with all {placeholders} filled in for this candidate/role
object_schema.expected_answer_type: text | number | boolean | enum | date | duration

validation.rule: string — how to validate the raw answer (e.g. numeric range, regex, enum match)

routing.on_answer: next_question_id, or a rule such as 'if answer==false -> end_call'

example_flow_software_engineer.resolved_text: Hi Arjun, this is an automated screening call from Acme Corp for the Software Engineer position. Is this a good time to talk for about 10 minutes?

routing.on_answer: if true -> Q-SE-002; if false -> offer_reschedule_then_end_call

example_flow_software_engineer.resolved_text: Do you hold a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related field, as required for this role?

routing.on_answer: if true -> Q-SE-005; if false -> escalate_to_human (hard filter)

example_flow_software_engineer.resolved_text: How many years of experience do you have specifically in software development?
This role is based in Bengaluru. Are you willing to relocate?
By what date would you realistically be able to join if selected?
